- Tue 3/3: 9:30–12:30 PT

Option A: Tue 3/3, 10:00–11:30 (45-min interview + 30-min team sync)
Option B: Wed 3/4, 14:00–15:30
Option C: Thu 3/5, 09:00–10:30

Best,
